behavior: Only a signed-in user acts, and only for their own profiles: Privy ES256 access tokens verified locally
acceptance: A token signed with the configured ES256 verification key, issuer privy.io and audience = app ID passes; expired, other issuer, other audience, other alg or none, and bad signature each return 401
A valid token acting for a profile the user does not own returns 403; verification makes no network call per request
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: PASS. Both acceptance lines proven on real Postgres through a real HTTP server (httpapi/auth_test.go: 11 token cases, 5 ownership cases, all pass; pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test green with -race). Verified golang-jwt v5.3.1 source: WithValidMethods rejects none/HS256/ES384/RS256 before the key func runs; WithIssuer/WithAudience make iss/aud required when set; aud arrays match if any entry equals the app ID; nbf checked when present; kid/jku/x5u headers ignored (fixed key). P-256 curve enforced at construction. Matches Privy docs (ES256, iss privy.io, aud app ID, sub DID; sid not checkable locally). Client errors use fixed messages; tokens never logged. Deferring cmd/api + config wiring to F047 is fine: no protected route exists yet and F047 notes carry it. Non-blocking: (1) auth/auth.go:41 NewVerifier accepts empty appID; WithAudience("") then accepts any signed token whose aud array contains "" (config.LoadAPI rejects empty vars, so only a guard). (2) httpapi/auth.go:33 requireProfileOwner treats a missing user as "" and still queries; users.privy_user_id has no CHECK <> '', so returning 401/500 on an empty user would make misuse fail closed. (3) httpapi/auth.go:16 Bearer scheme match is case-sensitive (RFC 7235 says case-insensitive; Privy clients send 'Bearer'). (4) auth_test.go:187 no-network test only catches http.DefaultTransport use; the real proof is that internal/auth imports no net/http. (5) Tests assert status only, not the JSON error body shape. (6) service.go is tested from httpapi/auth_test.go, not service_test.go (rules.md naming).
